description: This file defines the API for a 'strvec' module that manages dynamic, NULL-terminated arrays of strings, including functions for initialization, manipulation, and cleanup of such arrays.

methods.name: strvec_init
methods.description: Initializes a strvec structure, setting its array pointer to an empty string vector.

methods.name: strvec_push
methods.description: Pushes a copy of a string onto the end of the array, duplicating the string.

methods.name: strvec_push_nodup
methods.description: Pushes an allocated string onto the array, taking ownership of the string.

methods.name: strvec_pushf
methods.description: Formats a string with printf-like syntax and pushes it onto the array.

methods.name: strvec_pushl
methods.description: Pushes a list of strings onto the array; the list must be NULL-terminated.

methods.name: strvec_pushv
methods.description: Pushes an array of strings onto the array.

methods.name: strvec_splice
methods.description: Replaces a segment of the array with new strings, allowing insertion or deletion.

methods.name: strvec_replace
methods.description: Replaces the string at a specified index.

methods.name: strvec_remove
methods.description: Removes the string at a specified index.

methods.name: strvec_pop
methods.description: Removes the last element from the array.

methods.name: strvec_split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on whitespace and pushes each token into the array.

methods.name: strvec_clear
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the array and resets it to empty.

methods.name: strvec_detach
methods.description: Detaches the internal array and returns it, leaving the strvec ready for reuse.
